title: Tress
description: Noise combed along a flow field — the walk re-reads its direction at every step, so the strands curve.

title: Tombac
description: Crumpled brass with a warm room on one side and a cold window on the other — facets return whichever they face.

title: Strigil
description: A warm and a cool field dragged sideways until they smear — five taps along an axis that fans across the frame.

title: Serigraph
description: A print rather than a ramp: five screens, one flat colour each, and what keeps it from reading as banding is where they stop — not at a level line but wherever a coarse mesh says.

title: Raking
description: One broad shaft laid across the frame — the distance to an oriented axis through a tight core and a wide spill, with the far end giving out — and the hand turns the axis.

title: Quicksilver
description: Liquid metal gathering and breaking, holding its own edge the way mercury does.

title: Pharos
description: A lighthouse turning inside sea fog — the blades die out where the banks are thick because the light is dimmed by what it crossed, not by how far it came, and a hand held up casts a real shadow that widens and fades as it falls away.

title: Planckian
description: The colour of a temperature: hot metal lights one channel at a time, red then green then blue, and the whole sequence from deep cherry through orange to white falls out of the order they switch on in.

title: Occultation
description: A dark body in front of a light, and only the part of the limb facing the source burns.

title: Komorebi
description: Leaf shadow where the coarse canopy casts the softest edge and the small gaps project discs of the sun; the hand moves through it like a breeze.

title: Laminar
description: A uniform stream flowing past bodies that are never drawn — the streamlines are exact everywhere, so they crowd where the flow crowds and have no edge to find.

title: Fetch
description: Ocean swell under a low sun — three long trains fanned off the heading, and what is drawn is the slope of the water rather than its height, which is why the sea is bands of light and no waves.

title: Fenestra
description: Shafts through a slatted window, made visible by dust smeared along the light rather than speckled across it.

title: Antipode
description: Two masses of light leaning against each other, brightest where they still disagree and black where neither reaches.

title: Chatoyance
description: A bundle of fibres lying almost parallel, lit from one side — the sheen is drawn by where each fibre points, and the cursor combs them.

title: Hyaline
description: Refraction through a height field with one index per channel — the split is in the glass, not painted on.

title: Ichor
description: A pool with a lip — the liquid stands proud at its own edge and bulges where it is touched.

title: Interference
description: Three slow emitters trading standing waves — bright fringes where the crests agree, black where nothing reaches.

title: Kirlian
description: A body ringed by its own corona, spikes crawling around the edge where the field is tightest.

title: Kindle
description: A fire front creeping across a field — char behind it, an ember line, licks above.

title: Nacre
description: Thin-film colour over a stretched shell grain — the orders slide as the pointer glances across, pearl one way and blush the other.

title: Orpiment
description: Marbled pigment with the warp fed back into itself, veins at one level set and dust drifting along the filaments.

title: Opalesce
description: A film a few wavelengths thick over a slow flowing ground — the interference tint multiplies the palette instead of replacing it, and the cursor thickens the film so colour travels out behind the hand.

title: Cyanotype
description: A hand-coated print: the brush that laid the sensitizer, the dry edge of the coat, and the tooth of the sheet.
